summary: A laptop exam in one Excel workbook: each sheet is a small business data task and you write the formulas. Marks are for the formula, not just the answer. Expect date functions (working days, weekday names), text functions (finding separators, splitting and joining text), lookups (including a slab or approximate-match lookup) and a PivotTable.
paper_format: MST Sep 2023: six parts in one workbook, 50 marks scaled to about 25. Save as <Name>_<RollNo>_EMDM_MST.xlsx.
marks_structure: Each part: compute outputs in labelled cells and show the formula used
repeated_topics: Date functions: working days between dates with holidays, weekday of a date
Text functions: position of separators, LEFT/MID/RIGHT, length, joining and case
Lookup with a second table, including tax slabs
